review_method: All captures inspected in labeled contact sheets; selected original/candidate top-rear and side captures at full size. Final candidate and comparative rider sheets inspected after corrective iteration.
findings: Original cargo is staggered, lower and follows a taper, unlike the previous parallel tall-case rows.
First checkpoint corrected cargo proportion, mounting angles, rack shelves and rear rider envelope.

Checkpoint review caught a remaining gap behind the saddle and a tail perimeter level with the cooling crown. Front cooling geometry moved forward/up and white rear plating lowered using existing vertices.
Final views show coherent tapered rear plating, lower staggered cases, preserved rider knee corridors and controls.
Rider proxy is an analytical cross-check; original design controls fit. Small thigh-radius approaches do not constitute signed collision certification.
limits: Original fused topology prevents true bare-frame isolation.
Four clean cargo cases approximate the generated stacked luggage masses; small pouch/latch complexity remains in textures or future approved work.
Retained atlases deform with the surfaces; anisotropic case resizing changes texel density. No new maps or texture rebake in this mounting pass.
Final dressed rider, wrist roll, moving joints/steering, case-lid sweep, structural loading and Unity performance are not validated.
